title: PublicError
description: Standardized public error envelope. Never exposes internal reason, stack trace, input data, or vendor info.

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code from canonical rows.

request_id.description: X-Request-ID echoed back for client correlation.

retryable.description: Whether the client may retry the same request.

retry_after_seconds.description: Present only when client_action is retry_after.
